title: Talk planner
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Common vocabulary: personal pronouns, my family, adjectives and moods
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 22 (Pupil PDF worksheet: talk planner)
intro: Lesson 22: Speaking task: introducing my family. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. اِسْمِي آدَمُ.
فِي أُسْرَتِي خَمْسَةُ أَشْخَاصٍ. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتَانِ.
أَبِي طَوِيلٌ وَكَرِيمٌ، وَأُمِّي لَطِيفَةٌ جِدًّا.
أَنَا سَعِيدٌ لِأَنَّ جَدَّتِي تَسْكُنُ مَعَنَا.

parts.text: Teacher answers about the example family: أُمِّي لَطِيفَةٌ جِدًّا.

questions.q: Write your four-part talk in the portal response box (or on the pupil PDF), practise it, then present it to the teacher on camera (about 45 seconds) and answer one question.
questions.a: A clear talk covering the four parts; one question answered

questions.q: Extend: add a sentence with an extended family word.
questions.a: For example: خَالِي يَسْكُنُ فِي بِرْمِنْغْهَام.

options: How many brothers do you have?
questions.a: A) How many brothers do you have?. كَمْ = how many.

questions.q: Which part of your talk was strongest?
Think again: what makes a talk easy to follow?
questions.a: Clear sentences in order, spoken confidently.
